L'échantillon comporte `r nrow(tt)` cas.

# Critère principal 

## Traitement initial

```{r}
#| label: tbl-desc
#| tbl-cap: Traitement initial

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(sex:any_other_comorbidity,tt_initial) |> 
  mutate(performance_status_ecog = fct_recode(performance_status_ecog,
    "0, 1, 2" = "0",
    "0, 1, 2" = "1",
    "0, 1, 2" = "2"
  )) |>
  dplyr::select(!starts_with("date")) |>  
 tbl_summary(missing = "no",
             by = tt_initial,
              statistic = stt,
              sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
   bold_labels() |> 
  add_overall(col_label = "**Total**  \nN = {style_number(N)}",) |> 
  add_p(test = ptest) |>
  bold_p() |>
   modify_header(label ~ " ") |>
  pexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "desc1", lg = TRUE) 
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-pyr
#| fig-cap:  Age Structure

tt |> 
apyramid::age_pyramid(agec, sex,
                      show_midpoint = FALSE) +  
    labs(
    title = "Age Structure",
    x = "years"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pink", "lightblue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = c("Female","Male"), breaks = c(-30,30)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Analyse en régression

Analyse multivariée en régression linéaire. 
On prend en compte tous les facteurs ayant une p-value < 0,2 en analyse simple. 

```{r}
#| label: tbl-princ1multi
#| tbl-cap: Traitement initial - régression
ttn <- tt |> 
    mutate(performance_status_ecog = fct_recode(performance_status_ecog,
    "0, 1, 2" = "0",
    "0, 1, 2" = "1",
    "0, 1, 2" = "2"
  ))

glm(tt_initial ~ age + performance_status_ecog + 
           tp53_status + chronic_obstructive_pulmonary_disease,
         data = ttn,
         family = "binomial") |> 
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) |> 
     bold_labels() |> 
  bold_p() |>
   modify_header(label ~ " ") |>
  pexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "desc1", lg = TRUE) 

```

Seuls l'âge et le statut TP53 semblent avoir un effet sur le choix du traitement initial.


## Analyse factorielle

\begin{notebox}[Attention !]
L'analyse factorielle est uniquement descriptive.
\end{notebox}


les scores CIRS & ECOG ainsi que le statut IGVH n'ont été renseignés que pour un patient sur deux & ne sont donc pas utilisables. 

```{r}
#| label: facto_prepa

ttn <- tt |> 
  dplyr::select(sex,
                initial_diagnosis:performance_status_ecog,
                tp53_status:renal_failure, any_other_comorbidity,tt_initial
) |> 
  dplyr::select(!starts_with("date")) |> 
    mutate(performance_status_ecog = fct_recode(performance_status_ecog,
    "0, 1, 2" = "0",
    "0, 1, 2" = "1",
    "0, 1, 2" = "2"
  ))

#nn <- estim_ncp(ttn)
tta <- imputeMCA(ttn, ncp = 0)
ttn <- tta$completeObs

rtt <- MCA(ttn, 
           graph = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-facto-var
#| fig-cap: Variance expliquée par axe

rtt |> 
fviz_screeplot(addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 10))
```

Les graphiques suivants sont à interpréter avec prudence, les axes représentés n'expliquant que 17 % de la variance totale. 

```{r}
#| label: fig-factovar
#| fig-cap: analyse factorielle (MCA) - variables

fviz_mca_var(rtt,
           repel = TRUE,
           col.var = "cos2",
            select.var = list(contrib = 20),
           gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
           ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-factocasigvh
#| fig-cap: analyse factorielle (MCA) - IGVH

fviz_mca_ind(rtt,
           repel = TRUE,
           geom = "point",
           habillage = "igvh_status",
           ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-factoecog
#| fig-cap: analyse factorielle (MCA) - ECOG

fviz_mca_ind(rtt,
           repel = TRUE,
           geom = "point",
           habillage = "performance_status_ecog",
           ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
```

Les principaux facteurs permettant de  distinguer les patients sont les
cormobidités, les marqueurs immunitaires ne semblent pas discriminants. À noter
que le traitement initial ne semble pas être un facteur discriminant. 

# Rechutes

```{r}
#| label: prepa-rechute

rech <- tt |> 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("if_alive_disease")) |> 
  mutate_all(~ ifelse(.x == "Relapse or progressive disease", 1, 0)) 

rechn <- rech
rechute <- rowSums(rech, na.rm = TRUE)

rech[,1] = rowSums(rech[,1:1], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,2] = rowSums(rech[,1:2], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,3] = rowSums(rech[,2:3], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,4] = rowSums(rech[,3:4], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,5] = rowSums(rech[,4:5], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,6] = rowSums(rech[,5:6], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,7] = rowSums(rech[,6:7], na.rm =TRUE)
rech[,8] = rowSums(rech[,7:8], na.rm =TRUE)
rech <- rech |> 
  mutate_all(~ ifelse(.x > 0, "Relapse", "No Relapse")) |> 
  mutate(id = tt$patient) |> 
  mutate(tt_initial = tt$tt_initial) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:8, names_to = "mois", values_to = "rechute") |> 
  mutate_all(as.factor)

## Recodage de rech$mois en rech$mois_rec
rech$mois <- rech$mois |>
  fct_recode(
    "M 12" = "if_alive_disease_status_m12",
    "M18" = "if_alive_disease_status_m18",
    "M 24" = "if_alive_disease_status_m24",
    "M 30" = "if_alive_disease_status_m30",
    "M 36" = "if_alive_disease_status_m36",
    "M 42" = "if_alive_disease_status_m42",
    "M 48" = "if_alive_disease_status_m48",
    "M 6" = "if_alive_disease_status_m6"
  )
rech$mois <- rech$mois |>
  fct_relevel(
    "M 6", "M 12", "M18", "M 24", "M 30", "M 36", "M 42", "M 48"
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rechutes1
#| tbl-cap: Rechute en fonction du traitement initial

tt$rechute <- as.factor(ifelse(rechute > 0, "Relapse", "No Relapse"))

tt |> 
  dplyr::select(tt_initial, rechute) |> 
  tbl_summary(by = tt_initial,
              statistic = stt,
              sort = all_categorical() ~ "frequency") |> 
  bold_labels() |> 
  add_overall(col_label = "**Total**  \nN = {style_number(N)}",) |> 
  add_p(test = ptest) |>
  bold_p() |>
   modify_header(label ~ " ") |>
  pexptabph(exp = expx, nomfich = classeur , nomsheet = "rechutes1", lg = TRUE)

```

Sur ce petit échantillon le nombre de rechute ne semble pas lié au traitement initial.
